title: EvalTask
description: One labelled evaluation task ingested into the deterministic eval dataset. This is the task-ingest contract: every fixture under evals/fixtures/**/*.json validates against it, and the deterministic graders in evals/runner/graders.ts consume exactly this shape. Real historical tasks (a production-pilot dependency, NOT a Phase 1 deliverable) reuse the same shape with a non-synthetic source and a fuller provenance record.

id.description: Stable, path-independent task id. The runner sorts by this for deterministic ordering.

source.description: Provenance class of the task. Phase 1 fixtures are all synthetic; real historical tasks are a production-pilot dependency, not a Phase 1 deliverable.

grader.description: Deterministic grader id. Must match a registered grader in evals/runner/graders.ts.

labels.description: Free-form tags for slicing eval results.

privacyClass.description: Privacy classification of the task payload. Synthetic tasks are always 'public-synthetic'.

provenance.description: How the task was obtained. Required so no fixture can silently masquerade as a real historical task.

input.description: The task payload handed to the grader. Shape depends on grader; kept open but must be a non-empty object.

expected.description: Expected grader output. Compared structurally by the deterministic grader.

provenance.author: ASEP contributors
provenance.note: Synthetic seed. NOT a real historical task.
